tasks.spec:
You are a read-only diagnosis scout. NEVER edit, create or delete anything inside /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge; never run git commands that change anything; never call a model or the network. You may only read files and write ONE output file: /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/diagnosis-scout/out/diagnosis.json (create the directory if needed).

TASK. Scene 1A of an interactive-fiction story had 21 'stuck turns' in a live test: the player typed a command and the engine matched none of the story's authored outcomes. Diagnose each turn by cause, the way the project's scene-fixing guide asks (read what was offered beside the scene data before proposing anything), and tie each cause to the project's recorded precedents. Read, in full: /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/packets-18c.copy.json (the 21 stuck turns: `key`, `player_input`, `narration`, `candidates_offered` (claim ids), `matched_candidate`, `match_issues`), /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A.yaml and 1A.match.yaml in the same folder (the claim ids appear there as `claim_id`, with a `says` sentence, `requires` facts and `reach` things), /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/factory/precedents/stuck_turns.md (the project's verified winners, losers and never-do rules) and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/docs/scene-fixing-guide.md.

OUTPUT. /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/diagnosis-scout/out/diagnosis.json: a JSON list with exactly one object per packet key (21 objects, the `key` copied exactly), each with these string fields: `key`; `player_intent` (one short sentence: what the player was trying to do); `offered` (the `says` sentence of each offered candidate, joined with ` | `, copied verbatim from the scene file, or `none offered`); `cause`, exactly one of: `lead_outside_scene`, `prerequisite_step_missing`, `talk_without_matching_storylet`, `examine_without_matching_reveal`, `invented_by_narrator`, `match_miss_on_offered_candidate`, `other` (`lead_outside_scene`: the player chased a place or thing outside the scene; `prerequisite_step_missing`: the command needed a step the engine should perform for the player; `talk_without_matching_storylet`: the player talked to someone and no authored outcome fits; `examine_without_matching_reveal`: the player examined something and no authored outcome fits; `invented_by_narrator`: the narration invented an object or event; `match_miss_on_offered_candidate`: an offered candidate plainly fits the command but did not match; `other`); `why` (one or two sentences naming the evidence in the packet and the scene file); `precedent_quote` (a verbatim quote of at least eight words from `factory/precedents/stuck_turns.md` that bears on this cause, or the exact string `none`); `precedent_side` (one of `winner`, `lost`, `never_do`, `rule`, `none`, naming the section of that bullet). Report only what the files show; when the cause is unclear use `other` and say so in `why`. Do not write fixes or advice.
tasks.verified: Exactly 21 rows, one per stuck turn, each with an allowed cause; every offered sentence exists verbatim in the 1A scene file and every precedent quote exists verbatim in the precedents file.
